content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the plunge district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property specifically an apartment basement the court assigned each party a 50 share of the basement the court also recognized the defendants personal obligation towards a credit agreement and a court order the case involves a divorce with the applicant requesting the annulment of the marriage and division of property the court dissolved the marriage due to the fault of the defendant and awarded personal property rights to both parties the court also established financial obligations for the defendant there are allegations of abuse and infidelity and the applicant argues that the defendant should be held responsible for the dissolution of the marriage the court will consider the value of assets acquired during the marriage and the applicants health in making a decision on the division of property the court must follow the procedures outlined in the civil code for dividing matrimonial property the court may deviate from equal shares based on certain circumstances in this case the court awarded the entire apartment to the applicant due to their deteriorating health the court also determined that the defendants credit obligation is a personal obligation the costs of the divorce proceedings and division of property are settled according to the rules of the civil procedure code the court granted the applicants claim for divorce and awarded a portion of the division of property and compensation the court dismissed claims for maintenance and nonmaterial damages the defendant was ordered to pay the stamp duty and legal aid costs
